Nicoll 2.0 Brief
Reference Video

https://www.tiktok.com/@nicollmontoya.creator/video/7684327907027733791

Basic Content Structure

Exaggerated contrarian hook → immediate body proof → resonance around a past pain point → product introduction with two key selling points → scenario-based CTA + promotion

Keep the same direct, conversational format as the reference video:

  • The same filming style: a mix of selfie talking shots and fixed-camera shots.
  • One clear, specific bloating situation.
  • An exaggerated, unexpected statement at the beginning to create a strong hook.
  • A visible flatter-looking waist and stomach.
  • A clear contrast between the past bloating pain point and the current routine.
  • A direct, strong shopping CTA at the end.
  • Keep each video no more than 60 seconds.

Video 1 — Shortened Original Version

Wardrobe and Appearance
  • Wear a top that shows your flatter-looking stomach, paired with wide-waistband jeans. Your flatter-looking stomach should be clearly visible. Choose a bright-colored top that does not blend into the background.
Scene
  • Use the same bright indoor kitchen setting. Make sure the table in front does not block your flatter-looking stomach.
Filming Sequence — A
Hook

Use the same exaggerated contrarian hook:

MUST HAVE On-screen Text:
Flat in the morning.
Pregnant by 4 PM?
Same.
Hook

Establish a specific situation. Show the time on your phone. Lift your top to show your super flat stomach.

Body

Show a comparison between a previous bloating photo and your current flatter-looking stomach.

Body

Introduce the product and the simple product mechanism.

Body

Explain the ingredients and that it is tasteless.

CTA

Show your flatter-looking stomach and the specific scenario again. Flat tummy and strong CTA.
